tasks.title: Run full test suite and verify all tests pass
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Run the full Vitest test suite to verify all existing tests pass without modification.
2. READ FIRST: src/components/Calculator.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, src/App.test.tsx to understand what is being tested.
3. FILES: No files to modify — this is a read-only validation task.
4. APPROACH: Run `npx vitest run` from the project root to execute all tests. Capture output and verify exit code is 0.
5. PATTERNS: Follow existing test patterns already in place with Vitest setup in vite.config.ts and src/test/setup.ts.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run exits with code 0
All test suites in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx pass
All test suites in src/components/Button.test.tsx pass
All test suites in src/components/Display.test.tsx pass
All test suites in src/App.test.tsx pass
